consumption.operatorHoursNote: Same open question as M3-04: the ceiling is fixed in human operator hours and this artifact was authored by an agent, so no comparable figure exists. mi3san decides how agent-executed work enters the Track A cost axis.
consumption.ceilingReached: nativeAssetVersions is at the approved maximum of 1. Any change to the B2 keys or exposure sheet requires a new M3-03 decision first.

productionConditions: Five key drawings authored as named closed vector paths: K-closed, K-part, K-open, K-contact, K-open-tongue.
An 85-frame exposure sheet covering the T1 opening ramp and the T3 closure. T8 is not authored here; a 6-10 second performance belongs to P3, not to P1 mechanism evidence.
Cost scales with the number of distinct shapes, not with the length of the take. This is the axis on which B2 differs most from a controllable rig.

observedCeiling.observed: The contact pose splits the aperture into two holes while both corners stay parted. A single closed vector path cannot carry two holes, so the pose is authored as separate left and right paths and no correspondence to the single-hole open key exists.
observedCeiling.consequence: The approach into T3 contact lands as a cut, not an inbetween.
observedCeiling.evidence: classifyTransition('K-open', 'K-contact') returns hold-cut with reason 'path set changes'

observedCeiling.observed: Revealing the tongue introduces a path absent from the neighbouring keys.
observedCeiling.consequence: The tongue can only arrive on a cut.

observedCeiling.observed: Time is discrete by construction. Frames inside a block are held or linearly inbetweened; there is no continuous control between drawings.
observedCeiling.consequence: Not a defect. It is the property that makes B2 a ceiling reference rather than a mechanism comparable to a rig.
observedCeiling.evidence: the largest single-frame step exceeds 20 percent of the whole aperture range, asserted in pipeline/m3/b2/keys.test.ts

notMeasuredHere: Whether the cuts read as acceptable at normal speed. That needs real frames and mi3san's eyes, not an assertion.
The drawn look itself. These keys carry shape and topology, not the finished rendering quality a 2D artist would reach.
T8. A 6-10 second performance is P3 scope.

notEvaluated.note: B2 is the quality-ceiling control. It is never ranked beside A/C/D/E; pipeline/m3/b2/conformance.ts fails if it is relabelled as a core comparison member.
